mbx cache largest

`mbx cache largest` [​](#mbx-cache-largest)

- **Usage:** `mbx cache largest [--limit <LIMIT>]`

List the largest objects and action-result records.

## Flags [​](#flags)

- **`--limit <LIMIT>`** — Maximum entries to print.

  **Default:** `20`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
